content: {"praised":["Style and substance combine for exciting, intelligent sci‑fi action.","Visuals are revolutionary, groundbreaking, and highly impressive.","The film delivers tense, thrilling, and well‑paced sequences.","Music complements the high‑energy, futuristic atmosphere.","Characters are compelling, especially the lone hero’s journey."],"criticized":["Plot lacks realism, relying on fantasy elements.","Story structure feels disjointed and poorly explained.","Philosophical concepts are cheap and superficial.","Ending is clichéd and unsatisfying.","Science explanations are too far‑fetched."]}
